'''Alex Lam You Have HOW Many Corvettes''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alex Lam]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Have HOW Many Corvettes?
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth You Have HOW Many Corvettes Lam L.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Well, this is as good a Rebel space deck as I have found. Don't worry too much about Monnok. It doesn't hurt as much as people think it would.

== Strategy ==

Starting with Echo Command Center gives you enough force to draw for your other locations. Dantooine is a must so there are 4 of them in there. Play as many Corvettes as needed to hold a location (often 2 Corvettes and a pilot will do the job). The low destiny of this deck is actually a plus. You should be able to Sense and Alter with only an ability 2 character out, as well as being able to Collide his Star Destroyers without many problems (37 ones and zeros in this deck). In space you'll have to rely on sheer power to hurt your opponent. Don't worry. Even a couple Star Destroyers won't be able to fight off 8 Corvettes.

Use your Savrips if you need to fight on the ground. If you lose a battle, forfeit a Corvette from your hand. Having Houjixes in the deck allow you to deploy a Corvette early wihtout worrying about it being attacked. (This also works for deploying a ground character early in a location your opponent has deployed). Don't worry about your War Room, a drain of 1 isn't worth stopping. Make sure to control Kessel as it is the only good force drain location for Light Side in Space. Lastly, try to avoid stockpiling cards in hand unless you have at least 2 senses. Even though I said that Monnoks don't hurt too much (4 Corvettes is still only a fourth of your fleet), you can also lose your Alters and Savrips. All in all, you should never have much of a problem with the Dark Side in space.
